extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet identifies LMBT3906LT1G and S-LMBT3906LT1G as LRC (Leshan Radio Company, Ltd.) PNP silicon general-purpose transistors; the exact requested MPN is LMBT3906LT1G.

PNP collector-current, base-current, collector-emitter-voltage, base-emitter-voltage, VCE(sat), and VBE(sat) coordinates retain the datasheet negative signs. Curve axes labeled in mA, MHz, or mV/degC were represented in SI units A, Hz, and V/degC.
Curve points are sparse manual digitizations at visible grid positions from the typical characteristic plots on pages 5 and 6; no points were interpolated between sampled observations.

The DC current gain table provides minimum hFE values at IC = -0.1, -1, -10, -50, and -100 mA, plus a maximum of 300 at -10 mA. The guaranteed range at -10 mA is preserved as separate minimum and maximum gain points.

The first base-emitter saturation row publishes a minimum of -0.65 V and maximum of -0.85 V; the second row publishes only a maximum of -0.95 V. VCE(sat) is a maximum of -0.25 V at -10 mA and -0.4 V at -50 mA.
The strict BJT schema has no fields for IC maximum, PD, VCBO, VEBO, thermal ratings, switching times, or other small-signal h-parameter rows; those table fields were not added outside the schema.
omission_reason: VAF/Early voltage, VCBO, VEBO, continuous IC, power and thermal absolute ratings, switching times, and other h-parameter rows are not represented by this strict BJT extraction schema.
